integrity: The integer counting Gram formula and four explicit integer kernel vectors are checked by a direct enumeration, and ranks modulo two different primes are checked with independently enumerated state spaces. No probabilistic or floating-point numerical verification is used.
scientific_limitations: All claims concern fully labelled order-five alternating-sign matrices, joint observations of at most four cells, and exact finite ranks. Larger orders, minimal-support classification and conditioning are not claimed. Literature comparison is bounded; unindexed equivalent prior computations cannot be ruled out.
title: Exact cubic Fourier blind space and quartic recovery for order-five alternating-sign matrices
